{{Quote|We must keep our faith in the Republic. The day we stop believing democracy can work is the day we lose it.|Queen Jamillia|<ref name="AOC" />}}
'''Jamillia''' was a [[human]] [[Gender|female]] who served as the [[Monarch of Naboo]] as the successor of [[Queen]] [[Réillata]] during the [[Republic Era|final years]] of the [[Galactic Republic]]. She originally ran for the office as Queen [[Padmé Amidala Naberrie|Padmé Amidala]]'s term ended in [[28 BBY]], but lost to Réillata. Jamillia later served as Queen from [[26 BBY|26]] to [[22 BBY]], the outbreak of the [[Clone Wars]]. She was succeeded by Queen [[Neeyutnee]].

==Biography==
A [[human]] [[Gender|female]], Jamillia [[Homeworld|hailed]] from the [[planet]] [[Naboo]].<ref name="AOC" /> When [[Monarch of Naboo|Queen]] [[Padmé Amidala Naberrie|Padmé Amidala]], [[Politics|elected]] sovereign of Naboo, finished her two two-[[Standard year|year]] terms, her [[Naboo (people)|people]] tried to amend their constitution so she could remain in office. However, Amidala declined the honor, and Jamillia ran for the position of [[Queen]], but lost to [[Réillata]].<ref name="Queen's Shadow">''[[Queen's Shadow]]''</ref> Sometime later Jamillia ran again and was elected queen.<ref name="AOC" />

[[File:DB-QueenJamillia.png|thumb|left|220px|Jamillia in the throne room]]
In [[22 BBY]],<ref name="Timelines">''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]''</ref> Amidala was the victim of an [[Plot to assassinate Senator Amidala|attempted assassination]] by the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems]], a coalition of [[star system]]s that wished to [[Separatist Crisis|secede]] from the Republic. With Amidala's life threatened, both the [[Supreme Chancellor]] of the Republic and the [[Jedi High Council|High Council]] of the [[Jedi Order]] sent her to a [[Varykino|secure retreat]] on Naboo. At the beginning of Amidala's sojourn, Jamillia met her predecessor in the [[Theed Royal Palace|Royal Palace]], and the two discussed the probability of an imminent full-scale conflict between the Republic and the Separatists. Not long afterwards, those concerns came true as the [[Clone Wars]] broke out between the two factions.<ref name="AOC" />

Shortly after the outbreak of the war, Jamilla approached Amidala at [[Varykino Villa]] who was there recovering from the wounds she suffered at the [[First Battle of Geonosis|Battle of Geonosis]] asking her and her Jedi protector [[Anakin Skywalker]] to rescue five members of the [[Torada Collective]] who were on the Separatist occupied planet [[Nooroyo]] when the war broke out. When the [[Mission to Nooroyo|mission]] was completed however only [[Antraya]], Jamilla's sister, choose to return home to Naboo. Jamilla reunited with her sister in the palace shortly after.<ref name="Queen's Hope" />

After a four-year reign, Jamillia was succeeded by Queen [[Neeyutnee]].<ref name="Timelines" />

==Personality and traits==
Queen Jamillia was relatively small, measuring 1.57 [[meter]]s.<ref name="DB Jami" /> She had a round face with full lips, a narrow chin and pronounced cheeks. Both her [[hair]] and [[eye]] [[color]] were dark brown. She was an ardent defender of [[democracy]], and she also genuinely cared for the safety of her senator, Padmé Amidala.<ref name="AOC" />

==Equipment==
Jamillia wore a black [[Clothing|robe]] and a golden headdress.<ref name="VE">''[[Star Wars: The Visual Encyclopedia]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Jamillia was portrayed by [[Wikipedia:India|Indian]] actress [[Ayesha Dharker]] in the [[2002]] film {{Film|II}}.<ref name="AOC" /> In some early scripts of Episode II, the character was identified as "Jamilla."<ref name="Spelling Discrepancies">{{SWBoards|url=thread.jspa?threadID=158725&start=75#11220749|thread=Spelling Discrepancies|user=[[Leland Chee|Tasty Taste]]|date=2005-06-06|time=9:57 AM}}</ref> Dharker spent a month in [[Wikipedia:Australia|Australia]], a week and a half in [[Lake Como]] and then a few days in [[Wikipedia:Caserta|Caserta]], [[Wikipedia:Italy|Italy]] for only half a day of shooting.<ref name="SWArchive-The Dharker Side: An Audience with Queen Jamillia">{{SWArchive|url=episode-ii/bts/profile/f20020903/index.html|text=The Dharker Side: An Audience with Queen Jamillia}}</ref>
